name: Duka · Electronics Shop
intro: You will play in the example shop (Baraka Electronics in Nakuru): sell a phone with an M-Pesa message, sell on deni, restock, take a deni payment, book a repair, make an offer, count the cash, record money out and a bill, read the report, then start your own empty shop. Never press a 💬 WhatsApp, 📩 Text, 📞 Call or Remind button — they would open your real WhatsApp or messages.

steps.do: When the app opens, it says “Karibu to Duka” with two big buttons. Tap “🧪 Keep the example shop to play with”.
steps.see: The Today screen of an example shop: “Baraka Electronics” at the top, a note “This is an example shop. Play with anything — nothing is real.”, “Good morning, Wanjiru 👋” (or afternoon/evening), four boxes (Sales today, Profit today, Cash in the drawer, M-Pesa), an orange “🛒 New sale” button and a “NEEDS YOU” list that starts “3 items running low”.
steps.tip: A purple “🧪 Test copy” pill at the top means you are in a safe test copy: it disappears when you close the tab.

steps.do: In “NEEDS YOU”, find “Faith Achieng's Samsung A10 is ready” and tap “Tell” next to it. Read the message, but do NOT press 💬 WhatsApp or 📩 Text it. Tap “I told them another way”.
steps.see: First a window “🔧 Tell Faith” with a message that starts “Habari Faith! Your Samsung A10 is fixed and ready to collect…” and says KSh 2,500. After “I told them another way” the window closes and Faith's line is gone from Needs you.

steps.do: Tap 🛒 Sell at the bottom. In “Find an item” type the word below, then tap “Tecno Spark 20” in the list.
steps.see: Under the search, a box shows “Tecno Spark 20” with − 1 ＋ and the price 16999 “each”, and “Total KSh 16,999”.

steps.do: Tap the quick button “＋ Screen protector (glass)”. Then tap the Spark's price box, change it to the number below, and tap somewhere outside the box.
steps.see: Two items in the sale. An orange warning under the Spark: “⚠️ Below what you paid (KSh 14,500). You lose KSh 500.”

steps.do: Change the Spark's price again to the number below and tap outside the box.
steps.see: The warning is gone. “Total KSh 16,800”.

steps.do: In “Customer” type the name below. A phone box appears: type the phone number below. Leave the tick “They said yes to offers…” ticked.
steps.see: “New customer — they will be saved.”, the phone box with 0711 000 111, the ticked box, and a note about Kenya's Data Protection Act.

steps.do: Under “Paid by”, 📲 M-Pesa is already chosen. Tap the box “Paste the M-Pesa message”, type (or paste) the message below exactly, then tap “Fill from message”.
steps.type: QJK3XYZ12A Confirmed. Ksh16,800.00 received from AKINYI ODHIAMBO 0711000111 on 16/10/26 at 3:15 PM. New M-PESA balance is Ksh70,340.00.
steps.see: The “M-Pesa code” box now says QJK3XYZ12A and a green line says “✓ The message says KSh 16,800 — it matches.”
steps.tip: If you typed a different amount by mistake, a red line says it does not match — that is the app working. Fix the amount in the message and tap Fill again.

steps.do: Tap the green “✅ Save sale”. Read the receipt, but do NOT press 💬 WhatsApp or 📩 Text it. Then tap “Next sale ›”.
steps.see: A window “✅ Sale saved” with a receipt: “Baraka Electronics, Nakuru”, “1 × Tecno Spark 20 — KSh 16,500”, “1 × Screen protector (glass) — KSh 300”, “TOTAL KSh 16,800”, “Paid: M-Pesa QJK3XYZ12A”, a 🛡️ warranty line with a date one year from today, and “Asante Akinyi for shopping with us!”. After Next sale you are on an empty New sale.

steps.do: Tap the quick button “＋ Fast charger 25W (Type-C)”. Under “Paid by” tap “📒 Deni”. Leave Customer empty and tap “✅ Save sale”. Then type the name below in Customer and tap “✅ Save sale” again. Close the receipt with ×.
steps.see: The first time a message says “Deni needs the customer’s name and phone.” and nothing is saved. The second time (Peter is already a customer) the receipt says “Paid: Deni (to pay later) — still owed KSh 800”.

steps.do: Tap 📦 Stock at the bottom. Then tap the button “⚠️ Running low (3)”.
steps.see: Two boxes: “Stock at what you paid” and “Stock at selling price”. The list shows three items: Memory card 64GB “Out” (red), Infinix Hot 40i “1 left” and Phone cover “3 left” (orange).

steps.do: Tap “Infinix Hot 40i”, then “📥 Restock”. In “How many came in” type 5, in “Supplier” type the name below, leave “Paid from” on M-Pesa, and tap “Add to stock”.
steps.see: A message “5 added. Infinix Hot 40i: 6 in stock.” The Running low list now has only Memory card 64GB and Phone cover.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Reorder list (2)”. Read it, then close it with ×.
steps.see: “Order for Baraka Electronics — (today's date)”, then “• Memory card 64GB × 8 (we have 0)” and “• Phone cover × 17 (we have 3)”, and buttons 📋 Copy and 💬 WhatsApp.

steps.do: Tap 👥 Customers at the bottom, then “📒 Owe me”. On Peter Otieno's KSh 6,999 line tap “Record payment”. Change the amount to the number below and tap “Save payment”.
steps.see: Before: “Customers owe you” with two Peter Otieno lines (KSh 6,999 for a Tecno Spark 20, and KSh 800 for the charger). After: a message “Saved. Still owed: KSh 4,999” and the line now says KSh 4,999.

steps.do: Tap “🔧 Repairs”, then “＋ Repair came in”. Fill the boxes in order with the words below (customer, phone, item, problem, price) and tap “Save”.
steps.type: Mary Wairimu · 0722 333 444 · Itel A70 · Battery drains fast · 1500
steps.see: A new line “#R4 · Itel A70 Fixing” with “Mary Wairimu · Battery drains fast · KSh 1,500” and a “Mark ready” button.

steps.do: On the Itel A70 line tap “Mark ready”. Then tap “Collected & paid” on the same line, and “Save”.
steps.see: After Mark ready: the label says “Ready” with buttons “💬 Tell them” and “Collected & paid”. After saving: the label says “Collected” and the line moves down the list.

steps.do: Tap 📣 Offers at the bottom, then the orange “📣 New offer”. In “Which item?” keep “Samsung Galaxy A15 — KSh 22,500”. Under “Who gets it?” tap “Bought a phone”.
steps.see: The message fills itself: “Habari {name}! New at {shop}: Samsung Galaxy A15 is here, KSh 22,500 with 12 months warranty…”. A green box says how many customers will get it, how many are left out (for example Grace Wambui, who did not say yes), and shows what the first customer will see, with their own name and the shop's name.
steps.tip: {name} is not a mistake: it becomes each customer's first name when you send.

steps.do: Tap “Save and start sending ›”. Do NOT tap 💬 or 📩. Scroll down and tap “📋 Copy for WhatsApp Status”.
steps.see: A page “New stock: Samsung Galaxy A15” with the message (it shows “(their name)” where each name will go and ends “Reply STOP if you do not want these messages.”), “Sent 0 of …”, a list of customers each with 💬 and 📩, and a message “Copied — paste it in your WhatsApp Status or group.”

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money at the bottom (🧮 Cash is open). Look at the grey number in “Cash counted”: type a number 300 LESS than it. In “M-Pesa balance” type exactly the grey number you see there. Tap “Save the count”.
steps.see: A red box: “Cash is SHORT by KSh 300 · M-Pesa matches ✓” and advice to check today's sales and money out. The count appears at the top of “Past counts” with a red “Short KSh 300”.

steps.do: Tap “➖ Money out”. In the paste box type (or paste) the message below, and tap “Fill from message”. Then tap “Save money out”.
steps.type: QJK7X2K9LM Confirmed. Ksh2,000.00 paid to KPLC PREPAID. on 14/10/26 at 8:30 AM New M-PESA balance is Ksh38,000.00.
steps.see: Before saving: Paid to “Kplc Prepaid”, What for “Electricity (KPLC)”, Amount 2000, code QJK7X2K9LM, Receipt “M-Pesa message”. After: “Saved: KSh 2,000 to Kplc Prepaid.” and it is first in “This month”.

steps.do: Paste the SAME message again, tap “Fill from message” and “Save money out”. When the phone asks a question, tap Cancel.
steps.see: The question: “This code QJK7X2K9LM is already recorded. Save it twice?” After Cancel, the list still has only ONE Kplc Prepaid line from today.

steps.do: Tap “🧾 Bills”. Next to “Watchman — night security” tap “Pay”, then “Paid — record it”.
steps.see: Watchman now has ✅ and “paid (today)”. “Still to pay” goes down to KSh 12,000 (Brian's pay).

steps.do: Tap “📊 Report”, keep “This week”, read it, and tap “📋 Copy for WhatsApp”.
steps.see: A report that starts “📊 Baraka Electronics, Nakuru — Week …” with Sales and profit, Top sellers, Money out, “🧮 Last cash count: … SHORT KSh 300”, bills, “📒 Customers owe (deni)” with Peter Otieno, running low, repairs and offers. A message “Copied — paste it in WhatsApp.”

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻). Tap 🏠 Today.
steps.see: Everything is kept: “Baraka Electronics” at the top, and in “Recent sales” the Tecno Spark 20 sale with Akinyi Odhiambo and the charger on Deni for Peter Otieno.

steps.do: Tap 💵 Money → “⚙️ Settings”, scroll down, tap “🧹 Start over — clear everything” and OK. Type the words below (shop name, your first name, town) and tap “Open my shop ›”.
steps.see: An empty shop: “Kilele Phones” at the top, “Good … , Brian 👋”, Sales today KSh 0, and “No sales yet. Tap 🛒 New sale.”
steps.tip: After 5 pm, “Needs you” may say “Count the cash before you close.” — that is correct for a new shop.
